As per the latest update, Kantara has earned a mammoth total of 193 crores nett (all languages) at the Indian box office in 27 days. It equals 227.74 crores gross. Combining the overseas collection of 15.30 crores gross, the worldwide total jumps to 243.04 crores gross. With this, the film has surpassed KGF Chapter 1 ‘s 240 crores gross.
